comparison.objective: Unload three fruit items while avoiding another moving robot arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Collision-aware grasping and transfer amid dynamic interference.
comparison.success_condition: Fruit rests in the destination tray; any inter-arm contact invalidates the run.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic collision avoidance and ordinary pick-and-place rather than bimanual tool use, impact regulation, or fragment containment.
